title: ABID UTHA RAHE HAIN APNI BAHAN KA LAASHA ZINDAAN-E SHAM ME AB EK HASHR SA HAI BARPA
body:
Godi hai Jiski sooni ujda Suhag Jiska
Karbal me so raha ho jis Maa ka Jhoole wala
Us Maa ke Dil ko kaise dega koi dilasa
<<MINI>>
Abid Utha Rahe Hain Apni Bahan ka Laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas ki Bhatiji paiham tamache Khaake
Aayi thi Karbala se zulmo sitam Uthake
Khamosh Hogayi kyu'n roodaade Gham sunake
<<MINI>>
Abid Utha Rahe Hain Apni Bahan ka Laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba ko yaad karke Rone bhi Wo na Paayi
Seena kaha'n se milta Sone bhi Wo na Paayi
Zakhmo'n ko Aansuo'n se Dhone bhi Wo na Paayi
<<MINI>>
Abid Utha Rahe Hain Apni Bahan ka Laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
Rukhsaar neelgu'n hain Kurta phata huwa hai
Kaano se khu'n hai jaari zakhmo ka silsila hai
Har Naaz uthane Wala Karbal me Soraha hai
<<MINI>>
Abid Utha Rahe Hain Apni Bahan ka Laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
Bimar-e Karbala Par tooti nayi musibat
Hoti haiab Sakina Ahle Haram se rukhsat
Zinda'n me banrahi hai Nanhi si ek Turbat
<<MINI>>
Abid Utha Rahe Hain Apni Bahan ka Laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek aakhri Wasiyat Bhai se Usne Ki thi
Lekin Wasiyat Uski puri na hone paayi
Zinda'n hi me Rasheed ab Turbat banegi Uski
<<MINI>>
Abid Utha Rahe Hain Apni Bahan ka Laasha
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
